user.title: Project Cyder
user.description: Select the ESPHome CYD device whose alert actions should be used.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure CYD device
reconfigure.description: After installing firmware with the alert actions, select the ESPHome device again and reload this entry.

error.invalid_rules: One or more alert rules are invalid. Check their entity, threshold, priority, title, and message.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: This entry must remain linked to its originally selected ESPHome device. Remove and re-add the integration to monitor a different device.

init.title: Alert rules
init.description: Add any number of threshold rules. Above/below comparisons are strict; hysteresis controls when an active rule clears.

actions_unavailable.title: ESPHome alert actions unavailable for {device_name}
actions_unavailable.description: This integration needs the device-prefixed display_alert, clear_alert, and dismiss_alert services from ESPHome. Check that this entry selects the correct ESPHome device, install/enable firmware exposing all three actions, then reload or reconfigure this integration entry. Threshold alerts are non-dismissible so HA remains the source of truth.

init.title: Reconfigure the CYD ESPHome device
init.description: First install/enable the firmware actions display_alert, clear_alert, and dismiss_alert in ESPHome. Continue to select the device again; the integration will verify its registered action services when it reloads.

abort.entry_not_found: The Project Cyder entry no longer exists.
